questionnaire.title: Financial Services Risk Candidate Profile
questionnaire.description: FS Risk-specific skills and experience for banking, insurance, asset management, and fintech risk roles. Covers credit, market, liquidity, operational risk, and operational resilience. Excludes compliance risk (separate domain).

0.label: No Experience
0.description: No exposure or experience in this area

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands concepts; can interpret outputs; works under supervision

2.label: Practical Application
2.description: Can apply frameworks independently; works autonomously on standard tasks

3.label: Implementation & Management
3.description: Can implement, adapt and lead frameworks; manages specific contexts

4.label: Strategic Leadership
4.description: Can design from first principles; creates methodologies; enterprise-wide scope

questionnaire.interviewNote: All self-assessed proficiency ratings will be explored during interviews. Be prepared to provide specific examples demonstrating your claimed level of expertise, particularly for regulatory frameworks and quantitative methods.

sections.title: Additional Information
sections.description: Share anything else that demonstrates your value as a candidate
sections.helpText: This is your opportunity to highlight achievements, results, and career progression that haven't been captured elsewhere

questions.question: Key Achievements & Exceeding Expectations
questions.description: Describe examples from previous roles where you exceeded expectations, met challenging targets, or took on responsibilities beyond your role
questions.placeholder: e.g., 'Led emergency response to major market stress event; Built enterprise risk framework from scratch that survived regulatory scrutiny; Selected to lead integration risk workstream for major acquisition...'

questions.question: Quantifiable Results & Impact
questions.description: Share specific metrics that demonstrate your impact, such as risk reductions, model improvements, cost savings, or business outcomes you have delivered
questions.placeholder: e.g., 'Reduced operational losses by £2.3M annually through enhanced control framework; Improved model performance reducing capital requirements by 15%; Delivered GRC platform implementation 20% under budget; Reduced risk reporting cycle time from 15 days to 3 days...'

questions.question: Career Progression & Promotions
questions.description: Describe your career trajectory, including promotions, expanded responsibilities, or recognition of your value by previous employers
questions.placeholder: e.g., 'Promoted twice in 4 years at [Company], from Risk Analyst to Senior Manager; Selected to lead enterprise-wide risk transformation programme over more senior candidates; Headhunted by current employer to build out their risk function...'

questions.question: Your Unique Value
questions.description: What makes you stand out from other risk professionals? What unique combination of skills, experiences, or perspectives do you bring?
questions.placeholder: e.g., 'Combination of front-office trading experience with deep risk expertise gives me credibility with the business; Quantitative background in data science allows me to bridge the gap between risk and analytics teams; Multi-sector experience across banking, insurance, and asset management...'

questions.question: Anything Else?
questions.description: Is there anything else you would like us to know about your skills, experience, or candidacy that you haven't had the opportunity to share?
questions.placeholder: Use this space to share any additional information that would help us understand your candidacy...
